title: Bloomberg Beta: Pre-Launch Book Talk with Roy Bahat
summary: Roy Bahat hosts Eric for a pre-launch Incorruptible book talk on Zoom — Bloomberg Beta's investor and operator network gets the book a week before publication, with attendees receiving pre-order copies.
blockquote:
This should be fun, and important -- Eric Ries, as you may have heard, has a new book coming out. Around how to design companies so that they resist the corrosive underside of success -- and stay true to the founder's intent.

Incorruptible!

We're hosting Eric for a book talk *before his book comes out* -- a week from Friday. May 8 at 12p PT on Zoom.
